dialogue.greeting_first: Welcome to Shamsterdam Bike Rental. You've already decided to rent one, haven't you. Let me tell you why you shouldn't.
dialogue.greeting_return: You're back. The bike is not. This is why we take deposits.
dialogue.greeting_undamaged_return: No damage? No damage at all? ...I don't believe you, but I respect the lie.
dialogue.greeting_loyal_customer: Ah, you again. Still alive. The statistics were not in your favor.
dialogue.insurance_pitch: The basic covers theft. The premium covers damage. The platinum covers your dignity. None of them cover your decision-making.
dialogue.insurance_premium: Twenty Sovs sounds like a lot until you're fishing your vacation out of a canal.
dialogue.insurance_platinum: The platinum tier. Nobody who buys this has ever used it. They're too cautious to need it. Funny how that works.
dialogue.crossing_warning: You want to bike across THAT? I've watched seventeen years of tourists try. The bikes come back. Sometimes.
dialogue.cycling_advice: Dutch cyclists don't stop. They don't swerve. They assume you will. Don't prove them wrong.
dialogue.damage_assessment_minor: This? This is nothing. I've seen worse before breakfast.
dialogue.damage_assessment_major: How did you even— No. I don't want to know. Let me get the form.
dialogue.damage_assessment_canal: The canal. Again. Do you know how cold that water is? The bike knows.
dialogue.farewell: Good luck. You'll need it. Everyone does.
dialogue.farewell_rental_active: Remember: the deposit is 150 Sovs. Your dignity is worth more. Allegedly.

services.dialogue_trigger: I need to rent a bike.

dialogue.greeting_american: American? Let me get the standard form. And the backup form.
dialogue.greeting_british: British? You'll want insurance. Trust me on this.
dialogue.greeting_australian: Australian. Okay, let me get the reinforced form.
dialogue.greeting_generic: Welcome! First time renting in Shamsterdam?
dialogue.insurance_pitch: Extra insurance is 20 Sovs. Yes, 20 Sovs seems like a lot until you see how much the bike costs.
dialogue.insurance_detail: Standard covers 'minor' damage. Dad defines minor. It's usually not what you think.
dialogue.cycling_question: Have you ever ridden a bike before? Like, in traffic? Where people want you dead?
dialogue.photo_request: Just a quick photo for our records. Smile! ...That's the face they all make.
dialogue.photo_return: Let me just get a photo of the bike. For comparison purposes.
dialogue.damage_prediction: I'm going to guess... tram tracks? It's usually tram tracks.
dialogue.damage_revealed: Called it. Tram tracks. Dad owes me five Sovs.
dialogue.farewell: Good luck! I mean it. Really.

nationality_tracking.description: Anneke keeps a tally of damage rates by nationality

dialogue.greeting: *looks up from bike* Hmm? Tourist. Looking for repairs, or just looking?
dialogue.history_1: Forty-seven years. I've fixed forty-seven years of tourist mistakes.
dialogue.history_2: The rental bikes used to be blue. Then orange became the 'tourist warning color.'
dialogue.history_3: Your group? I give you... three hours before the first one comes back bent.
dialogue.canal_wall: This bike came out of the canal. This one too. And this one. And— *gestures at entire wall*
dialogue.canal_philosophy: The canal takes. The canal gives back. Eventually. Usually bent.
dialogue.repair_offer: I can fix this. 25 Sovs. Come back in an hour.
dialogue.repair_impossible: This... this I cannot fix. This is art now. Tragic art.
dialogue.blessing: You want my blessing? *squints* Fine. May your wheels stay round and your chain stay oiled.
dialogue.quest_intro: The canal has many bikes. Many, many bikes. You want to help an old man recover some?
